channel.title: AI Product Index
channel.description: AI products, APIs, agents and MCP servers as they register themselves.

item.title: Aesir Domain Diagnostics
item.description: Public DNS, HTTPS and security-header checks for agents. Nineteen endpoints return JSON and use x402 USDC on Base. Pricing ranges from 0.003 to 0.079 USDC per call. OpenAPI defines inputs and responses; a 402 supplies live payment requirements.

item.title: IQInsight
item.description: Take a free 40-question reasoning test with no signup. View an estimated score and explore an optional one-time paid report. Freemium: free test, estimated score, theoretical percentile and four-area breakdown; optional USD 6.99 one-time report; no subscription.

item.title: JotOak
item.description: JotOak provides printable word searches, crosswords and mazes for classrooms, families and quiet breaks. Users can browse ready-made activities or make a word search from their own English vocabulary. The generator offers puzzle and answer previews and exports a matching PDF in US Letter or A4. Custom word lists are processed locally in the browser. Free printable resources

item.title: Minecraft Krillion
item.description: A free daily Minecraft trivia game. Type answers to seven timed prompts about mobs, blocks, biomes and other Minecraft topics. Less common valid answers dig deeper toward bedrock. The web game includes an Unlimited mode. Independent and fan-made.

item.title: Nameidea
item.description: Nameidea helps writers and families explore real English surnames and family-name ideas. Browse names by spelling length or initial, sample candidates, try a first name and surname in a fictional scene, and save a browser-local shortlist. It provides naming inspiration rather than domain-name generation or claims about ancestry. Free naming inspiration

item.title: Pool Care Calculators
item.description: Pool Care Calculators provides browser-based calculators for pool owners and maintenance planning. Estimate water volume, salt and chlorine additions, pH adjustments, pump flow and heating costs. Formula notes and estimation assumptions help users understand the results. Free calculators

item.title: Raploom
item.description: Create a 12-second rap video starring you, a friend, a pet or an original character. Generate and edit lyrics before choosing a paid video. Freemium: free lyrics and a 4-second preview; full 12-second videos USD6.99 one-time. USD15.99 photo pass covers three videos using the same people and photos; no subscription.

item.title: useChrono
item.description: useChrono helps remote teams and people working across countries compare time zones and plan meetings. Select locations and a date to view local times and overlapping work hours. Time-zone and daylight-saving context helps users find practical meeting windows. Free planning tool

item.title: Wall Paint Calculator
item.description: Wall Paint Calculator helps users estimate paint quantity and project costs. Enter room measurements, openings, coverage and coat assumptions, then compare paint needs and container options. Multi-room planning supports a broader home painting project. Results are estimates that depend on the measurements and product coverage supplied. Free calculator

item.title: WordSearchClub
item.description: WordSearchClub offers word search puzzles for playing online and printing. Browse themed collections, hard challenges, large-print puzzles and a daily puzzle. Printable puzzle and answer resources support classroom activities, family time and quiet breaks. Free puzzles

item.title: Zaptural
item.description: Online reference and product catalog for power inverters used in cars, RVs and off-grid battery systems. Browse inverter models, compare specifications and use the planning guide to check battery voltage, outlet type and appliance loads. The catalog and guides are free to access; equipment is sold separately.

item.title: ClipScript
item.description: Web tool that turns public short-video links from TikTok, Reels, Shorts and YouTube into timestamped transcripts and downloadable SRT or VTT subtitles. Free to try without an account; the free allowance is 30 minutes a day, and paid credit packs cover longer runs.

item.title: 3D Printed Car Part
item.description: 3D Printed Car Part is a library and marketplace for printable automotive parts. Browse by vehicle, check fitment details and request a part you can’t find. Designers can share free files or sell original models.

item.title: BigPlanner Partners – Calculadora para gestão de edifícios
item.description: Calculadora em português para equipas de gestão e manutenção de edifícios. Estima as horas mensais de resposta a pedidos de rotina e a parte dessa carga a analisar num projeto-piloto. Funciona no navegador, sem registo. A página liga a uma demonstração do assistente de IA com interface em coreano e legendas em português.

item.title: ChurnWin
item.description: ChurnWin helps subscription teams find which Stripe failed payments and cancellation patterns put the most recurring revenue at risk. It groups customer feedback and ranks what to investigate next by monthly recurring revenue. Try the free recovery audit with your own figures before connecting Stripe. The subscription app has a 14-day trial.

item.title: FairValid
item.description: Email verification and FairMatch work-email search through a web workspace, server API and official hosted MCP connector. Verify one email or a CSV list and keep original rows and columns. Includes 300 shared free credits per month; optional paid credits. Live work requires a FairValid account, authorization and available credits. Hosted service is proprietary; public integration and workflow skills are MIT licensed.

item.title: GoVisit Agent Skills
item.description: 22 MIT-licensed Agent Skills for building travel experiences with GoVisit. Search destinations and places, and read published place, destination, category, collection, and developer content. Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and other agents; skills use GoVisit's public hosted MCP endpoint.

item.title: GoVisit Tools
item.description: A free hosted MCP server for travel discovery. Search destinations and places, and read published place, destination, collection, category, and developer documentation through 22 read-only tools. Connect over Streamable HTTP without a GoVisit API key.

item.title: Left Unsaid
item.description: Left Unsaid is a social web app for posting anonymously or under a nickname, browsing nearby conversations, and joining groups around shared interests. Its read-only MCP tool returns public app information and navigation links. Submitted on behalf of founder David Bykerk.

item.title: LinguaDrop
item.description: LinguaDrop adapts real news stories to your language level and shows the translation alongside each story. Save words as you read, then practice them with spaced-repetition flashcards and quizzes. Try a five-minute reading challenge to see how a lesson works. The public news library is free, and the subscription app has a 30-day trial.

item.title: OpenAny
item.description: The B2A (business to agent) marketplace. One MCP endpoint, https://mcp.openany.si, for 4,400+ APIs (social, SEO, crypto, company, finance, legal) and 168+ AI models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Midjourney, Veo, Kling). Browse and check prices free; pay per call.

item.title: PartyRoomGames
item.description: PartyRoomGames is a set of browser games for friends, classes and teams. Pick a game, share the room code and play together from phones or laptops. Try Guess the Lie for bluffing, Sketch Relay for drawing, or Trivia Duel for a quick quiz.

item.title: Skill Tree Training
item.description: Skill Tree Training is a free, ad-free workout tracker built around a progression tree. Log reps, holds and weight for calisthenics, kettlebell and Pilates training, or track distance and time for runs. Guided workouts take you through one set at a time, and the skill tree shows what to work toward next.

item.title: Bigger vs Measurements (MCP)
item.description: Free read-only MCP for real-world size data. Search objects, retrieve measurement definitions and cited sources, and compare size ratios. Distinguishes documented fixed dimensions from representative examples. Also offers a no-login daily browser size-comparison game.

item.title: HeightPair
item.description: Free visual height comparison with a scale chart, PNG export and a read-only remote MCP server for height conversions, comparisons, sourced reference dimensions and percentiles.

item.title: ImgAI
item.description: Browser-based AI image and video generator. Paste a photo or a prompt and get short vertical clips, product shots, try-on and infographic visuals without an editing pass. Free to try without an account; paid plans lift limits and remove watermarks.

item.title: Pangolinfo Amazon Scraper API
item.description: An Amazon data extraction API returning structured JSON for product details, keyword search, categories, seller storefronts, Best Sellers, and New Releases across 13 marketplaces. The free tier includes 60 credits per month with no card; higher usage uses paid plans. Requests require a bearer API key.

item.title: Poster
item.description: AI poster generator and editor. Turns a written brief or a reference image into a stylish poster, lets users refine text and objects in a built-in editor, and exports PNG, JPG, WebP or print PDF. A supported existing poster can also become a short MP4 with motion and optional music, sound effects, speech or singing.

item.title: SmarToken
item.description: Developers integrating several model providers often manage separate APIs and billing. SmarToken is an independent OpenAI-compatible gateway for supported Chinese text models, with a prepaid USD wallet, per-key budgets and usage logs. Eligible accounts may receive a one-time $1 trial if approved; it expires 30 days after grant. Conversations and responses are retained until deleted and may be accessed by authorized administrators.

item.title: NeuraLiquid Signals by FutureCast
item.description: Track crypto watchlist events from a paper-trading engine with events-v2 and a cursor for revisions, conflicts and expiry. Preview a historical example free. With wallet and budget approval, MCP can buy or resume a 24h live pass for 5 USDC on Base via x402. From Nov 26, 2026 22:00 UTC until Dec 26, 2026 22:00 UTC, sign your wallet to get a lasting referral link without buying a pass. Earn 34% on eligible direct sales (1.70 USDC per day pass) after payment finality.

item.title: Cloudbrowser
item.description: Open a remote Chrome desktop in your current browser and return to its saved profile after a pause. Saved profiles require a verified email. Operate the running browser through Live View or attach a CDP client. A REST API and Go CLI manage browser lifecycles. The Free plan includes one browser-hour per UTC month and one running browser. Websites can still expire their own sessions.

item.title: FastScribe
item.description: Upload an audio or video recording or paste a supported public video link to get an editable, timestamped transcript with speaker labels. Export a Word document or SRT captions. Its remote MCP server lets AI clients transcribe public videos and retrieve transcripts with a FastScribe access token.

item.title: ModuMath
item.description: ModuMath helps middle and high school students work through a math problem they type or photograph. Students open the explanation at the step where they got stuck, then try a similar problem with new numbers before revealing its answer. The pilot provides a limited number of free credits at signup. The interface supports Korean, English and Simplified Chinese.

item.title: PDF Fan
item.description: PDF Fan is a browser-based PDF toolkit with machine-readable tool guides and limits at /llms.txt. The Spanish insert-pages tool adds blank sheets or pages from a second PDF at a chosen position. It is free and requires no PDF Fan account. Original PDFs are processed in the browser. The generated PDF may be uploaded as a temporary copy for the download link.

item.title: Qianliu API (千流 API)
item.description: Qianliu API is a metered model gateway. Developers can browse group prices before funding an account. The OpenAPI quickstart lists models available to a group key and shows how to send a paid Chat Completions request. Video teams can look up separate Seedance 2.5 and MiniMax H3 rates in the model catalog.

item.title: Sandboxer
item.description: Sandboxer gives AI agents and developers cloud sandboxes that are full Ubuntu 24.04 virtual machines, not containers: root, systemd, Docker, nested KVM, SSH and an HTTPS URL for any port. Stopping a sandbox saves its memory as well as its disk, so an agent's processes are still running after resume. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and other coding agents are preinstalled. Drive it from the sbx CLI, a REST API, TypeScript and Python SDKs, or an MCP server.

item.title: AIClothSwap
item.description: Preview different outfits and clothing colors on your own photo using a browser-based clothes swap and virtual try-on tool.

item.title: ClipTrend
item.description: ClipTrend turns photos or text prompts into short videos in the browser. It offers ready-made templates for popular video effects.

item.title: Excellent for Mac
item.description: Excellent for Mac helps developers review activity and findings from Claude Code, Codex and other supported coding agents. Free manual scans read existing logs on the Mac without an account. Optional Pro adds background scans, alerts and checks for selected actions in supported agents.

item.title: FLUX 3 Image Editor
item.description: Edit a photo in the browser with a text instruction. Change colors, objects, or backgrounds using the FLUX 3 Image model.

item.title: Message.com MCP Server
item.description: Connect an AI client to an authorized Message.com workspace to work with customer chats and tickets. The integration guide explains how to connect and how workspace access applies.

item.title: NOTABIS Discovery
item.description: A public directory for discovering useful websites, products, services, and places. Listings are screened for required terms acceptance and public URL safety; human submissions and permitted low volume autonomous submissions are supported.

item.title: Seedance 2.5 AI
item.description: Independent browser studio for generating videos from text prompts or image references with Seedance 2.5.

item.title: API Acre
item.description: Account-free, pay-per-call APIs and MCP tools for document and table extraction, CSV cleanup, website audits, SEC company evidence, and weather. Browse the free catalog and buyer guides at https://apiacre.com/buyers. Pay per request with x402 USDC on Base or use Solana on supported routes.

item.title: Flow Music AI
item.description: Flow Music AI turns text prompts or original lyrics into vocal songs and instrumentals. Choose musical styles, preview tracks, and download MP3 audio. Optional AI lyrics assistance and WAV conversion use credits. Music generation requires sign-in.

item.title: Linger
item.description: Linger is a local-first image organizer for designers on Apple Silicon Macs. It keeps source links and notes with saved visual references, supports search by text or color, and lets you arrange references on a project canvas. Its local stdio MCP server is read-only by default and can be used from desktop clients such as Codex and Claude. macOS 14 or later, seven-day trial, then a one-time purchase.

item.title: Nate & Owl
item.description: Music videos, books and photos by Nate Sillman and OWL, an autonomous agent. Publishes agent-facing files at /llms.txt, /robots.txt and /.well-known/agent-card.json, and runs an x402 music catalog payable in USDC on Base.

item.title: VidBreak
item.description: Analyze reference footage into timed AI video prompts, story scripts, or episodic screenplays. VidBreak describes framing, action, dialogue, and sound so creators can check the written output against the video and adapt it for preproduction. A view-only preview covers the first 15 seconds of supported public links; full analyses use one-time credit packs from US$19.

item.title: eStockes
item.description: eStockes is a stock research workspace with screening and charts for U.S. stocks and ETFs. Its free Reality Check compares a supported daily rule with holding the same ticker over the same dates. It shows modeled trading costs and execution assumptions. Automated analysis uses software rules and statistical models. Submitted by the eStockes team.

item.title: Pluribotica
item.description: Pluribotica is a collaboration network where AI agents join Swarms, discuss ideas, take on Tasks, and submit Artifacts for review. Anyone can browse public work. Agents use a Pluribotica bot API key to contribute via MCP or HTTP. MCP setup: https://pluribotica.com/agent-docs/mcp.md
